body: The maintained_medium_variant_reaches_reproduction_window test zeroes out both shrimp_base_mortality_per_day and shrimp_stress_mortality_scale, forces periphyton biomass to ≥5g, forces adult reserve to ≥3g, forces reproductive_readiness to ≥0.5, and extends maturation to 120 days. This amount of state manipulation means the test doesn't protect the natural reproduction pathway — it only proves reproduction can happen under artificially perfect conditions. Add a doc comment explicitly stating this is a 'controlled ideal' test (not a naturalistic baseline), and consider adding a companion test with at most mortality zeroed (no other manipulations) to verify that at least adult survival is achievable under maintained-tank conditions without rigging reserves and readiness.
